title: 第7章 青帝 我儿陆尘有大帝之姿第8章 融合木灵之气灵妃的谋划暗杀陆尘
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
而对于这四大宗门和两大书院，陆尘也是心中冷笑。
按照逆袭系统所言，未来，四大宗门和两大书院联合二皇子七皇子祸国殃民，把大乾搞的天翻地覆。
对于这些寄生在大乾的寄生虫，陆尘没有一丝好感！
“哼，且先让十一皇子接着测试！”
而这个时候，陆尘还来不及开口，只听青帝冷哼一声开口。
刹那间，恐怖的威压铺天盖地而来，四大宗门和两大书院的人一个个脸色苍白，一句话都不敢说，
这些书院和宗门之人最低也是帝境，还有几个天象境强者，被青帝一句话，直接给压的瑟瑟发抖。
就连陆地神仙境界的陆尘都被青帝的威压给震的内心一颤。
随后，陆尘不可思议的看着青帝。
本以为青帝是陆地神仙境界。
而自己也是陆地神仙境界。
然而，如今自己父皇的威压竟然把自己给震的心生战栗！
怎么可能，如此一来，只有一种可能。
青帝在扮猪吃老虎，他的境界，很有可能超越了陆地神仙的境界！
陆尘长呼了一口气。
自己这父皇，绝对不简单啊。
“殿下，这是玲珑铜镜，正是测试灵根之至宝，这玲珑铜镜照向他人，在镜面之中，便会绽放出光芒，分别是一彩到九彩，分别对应着一彩到九彩灵根！”
这个时候了，枯木道人拿出了一面玄妙的铜镜开口。
陆尘听到此言，却是点了点头。
随后，便伸出手接过玲珑铜镜。

低着头，陆尘拿着灵笼铜镜看向镜子中的自己，就在这一刹那。只见玲珑铜镜突然爆发出耀眼的九彩光芒。
几乎是一瞬间，这九彩光芒直接笼罩整个雏龙殿！
在这九彩光芒之下，除了陆尘之外，其他所有人啊，包括青帝在内，一个个全部瞪大了眼睛，脸上露出了目瞪口呆的神色。
嘭……
这个时候，一声清脆的响声，只见太虚剑宗的长老直接被吓的一屁股坐在了地上。
“这，这是九彩灵根，只在传说中传言，但是却从未出现获得九彩灵根！”
浩然书院的院长看到这一幕，声音沙哑，不敢自信的开口。
此刻，现场所有人看向陆尘的目光，尽皆露出了不敢置信的神色。
“无上剑体再加上九彩灵根，我儿陆尘，有大帝之姿！”
青帝在震惊过后，脸上却是露出了惊喜万分的神色。看着陆尘眼睛发光，情不自禁的开口。
此刻了，青帝恨不得把陆尘给含在嘴里。
如此天赋，实在是恐怖至极。
无上剑体加上九彩悟性，对于陆尘来说，陆地神仙境界只是一个开始。
陆地神仙境界之后的天人境才是开始！
“陛下！”
这个时候，只见浩然书院的院长直接噗通一声对着青帝跪下，歇斯底里声泪俱下的开口。
“还请让十一皇子加入我浩然书院，只要十一皇子加入浩瀚书院，浩然书院愿意把镇院之宝，天阶中品至宝浩然书给予十一皇子，浩然书院所有书生，愿意全部加入神朝，为陛下效命！”
浩然书院院长是一个五十多岁的中年男子，长得浩然正气，充满了威严，
但是此刻，浩然书院直接跪在青帝脚下，痛哭流涕的开口。
content_en:
Regarding these four major sects and two major academies, Lu Chen also sneered in his heart.
According to the counterattack system, in the future, the four major sects and the two major academies will unite with the second and seventh princes to bring disaster to the country and the people, turning Daqian upside down.
Lu Chen doesn't have a good impression of these parasites living in Daqian!
"Hmph, let the Eleventh Prince continue the test first!"
At this time, before Lu Chen could speak, he only heard Qingdi snort and speak.
In an instant, the terrifying pressure came overwhelmingly. Everyone in the four major sects and the two major academies turned pale and did not dare to say a word.
The people in these academy and sects are at the lowest level of the Emperor Realm, and there are also a few strong ones in the Celestial Realm. They were immediately suppressed and trembled by the Qing Emperor's words.
Even Lu Chen, who was in the realm of land gods, was shaken by the Qing Emperor's pressure.
Afterwards, Lu Chen looked at Qingdi in disbelief.
I thought that Qingdi was in the realm of land gods.
And he is also in the realm of land gods.
However, now, his father's pressure actually makes him tremble!
How is it possible? In this case, there is only one possibility.
The Qing Emperor is pretending to be a pig and eating a tiger. His realm is likely to surpass that of the land gods!
Lu Chen took a long breath.
My father is definitely not simple.
"Your Highness, this is an exquisite bronze mirror, which is the ultimate treasure for testing spiritual roots. When this exquisite bronze mirror shines on others, the mirror will bloom with light, from one color to nine colors, corresponding to one color to nine colors of spiritual roots!"
At this time, Taoist Kumu took out a mysterious bronze mirror and spoke.
When Lu Chen heard this, he nodded.
Then, he reached out and took the exquisite bronze mirror.
Lu Chen lowered his head, holding the spirit cage bronze mirror and looking at himself in the mirror, at this moment. I saw the exquisite bronze mirror suddenly burst into dazzling nine-color light.
Almost instantly, this nine-color light directly enveloped the entire Young Dragon Palace!
Under this nine-color light, except for Lu Chen, everyone else, including Qing Emperor, all opened their eyes with dumbfounded expressions on their faces.
Bang...
At this time, there was a crisp sound, and the elder of Taixu Sword Sect was frightened and sat down on the ground.
"This, this is the Nine Color Spiritual Root. It is only rumored in legends, but it has never been obtained!"
When the dean of Haoran Academy saw this scene, his voice was hoarse and he did not dare to speak confidently.
At this moment, everyone at the scene looked at Lu Chen with expressions of disbelief.
"With the supreme sword body and the nine-color spiritual roots, my son Lu Chen has the appearance of a great emperor!"
After Qingdi was shocked, a look of surprise appeared on his face. Seeing Lu Chen's eyes shining, he couldn't help but speak.
At this moment, Qing Emperor wanted to hold Lu Chen in his mouth.
Such a talent is really terrifying.
With the supreme sword body and the nine-color understanding, for Lu Chen, the realm of land gods is just the beginning.
After the realm of gods on land, the realm of gods and humans is just the beginning!
"Your Majesty!"
At this time, the dean of Haoran Academy knelt down to Qing Emperor with a loud bang and spoke hysterically with tears in his eyes.
"Please also allow the eleventh prince to join our Haoran Academy. As long as the eleventh prince joins the Haoran Academy, the Haoran Academy is willing to give the treasure of the town, the middle-grade treasure of the heaven, the Haoran Book, to the eleventh prince. All the scholars of the Haoran Academy are willing to join the Divine Dynasty and serve His Majesty!"
The dean of Haoran Academy is a middle-aged man in his fifties. He looks upright and full of majesty.
But at this moment, Haoran Academy knelt directly at the feet of Qing Emperor and spoke with tears in his eyes.
